description: Reviewed algorithm/inter-stage protocol constants only. Model, tokenizer, request, and runtime defaults must come from concrete configuration or payload metadata.

categories.config-owned: Model/checkpoint configuration should own this value.
categories.tokenizer-owned: Tokenizer metadata or token lookup should own this value.
categories.algorithm-protocol: The value is part of an algorithm, tensor layout, codec, or inter-stage protocol.
categories.request-runtime: Request or runtime configuration should supply this value.
categories.dead-constant: Suspected unused compatibility constant; remove only with model-specific validation.

allowlist.rationale: The talker exposes a two-slot continue/stop protocol; slot 1 is the stop class, not a tokenizer ID.
The sentinel is one past Gepard head-0's fixed FSQ range 0..7 and is consumed only by the sampler protocol.
These are codec stream ramp sentinels equal to the one-past-codebook protocol positions, not text tokenizer IDs.
PAD_GROUP_SIZE is the fixed interleaving group width shared by the MiMo tensor protocol.
The integer map serializes Ming stop-reason enum values across stages; it does not represent model tokens.
The silence lookahead code is part of the fixed MiniCPM token2wav codec protocol.
MAX_PROMPT_TOKENS reserves part of the fixed 10,240-position AR context for generated audio frames.
The talker emits a binary continue/stop classifier; values 0 and 1 are class indices rather than vocabulary IDs.
VoxCPM2 compute_logits exposes a binary continue/stop protocol whose stop class is index 1.
The stage bridge strips the same one-past-codebook ramp sentinels emitted by the Higgs codec stream protocol.
The value is the one-past-codebook pad code used to remove padded RVQ rows from the inter-stage tensor stream.
